_note: What the table still handles for gear and talents the engine only partly automates (src/core/rules/automation.gd). Keys: system/weapon id, or talent id:rank. Plain language for players.
ms_ramjet: While it's on you must move your full Speed in straight lines; move that way yourself.
ms_portable_bunker: The bunker's own 40 HP isn't tracked; if it's attacked, the GM keeps count.
ms_restock_drone: It primes at the end of your turn: don't use it on the turn you deploy it.
ms_bb_breach_blast_charges: Objects and walls caught in a Breaching Charge take 30 AP explosive; the GM applies that.
ms_reactive_weave: After Bracing you may move up to your Speed; make that move yourself.
ms_hunter_logic_suite: Terrify: the target can't move any closer to you; the GM keeps to that.
ms_tracking_bug: Removing the bug takes the target an Engineering check as a quick action; resolve that at the table.
ms_lotus_projector: It shows you HP, Evasion, E-Defense and heat of characters in its field; ask the GM for them.
ms_interdiction_field: Only characters you choose can teleport inside the field; the GM checks that.
ms_mesmer_charges: Mesmer Beacon (the target may only move toward you) is applied at the table.
ms_personalizations: Your personal mod can give +1 on a check if the GM agrees it helps.
ms_asura_class_nhp: Taking one extra full action instead of two quick actions isn't supported: take the quick actions.
ms_repulser_field: You're immune to the mines it sets off; the GM undoes their effects on you.
ms_aegis_shield_generator: It only reduces attack damage here; damage from other sources is reduced at the table.
ms_reinforced_cabling: Grapple Swing (a straight flying move on your standard move) is done at the table.
ms_webjaw_snare: Set it off by moving over its space; the GM tracks snares on paths the game doesn't check.
mw_pinaka_missiles: Delaying the strike to the end of the next round (3d6, you're Slowed) is done at the table.
mw_raleigh_integrated: Its free shot when you reload any weapon (1/round) is taken by hand.
t_centimane:3: Tidal Suppression lets you pick the extra effect; the game uses Harrying Swarm (Impaired and Slowed). Ask your GM to swap it.
t_siege_specialist:2: Afterwards you're pushed 1 space in a direction of your choice; move yourself.
t_drone_commander:1: The Shepherd Drone protocol is resolved at the table.
t_skirmisher:1: Forcing another character to make a save also ends the chaff; drop it yourself when that happens.
wm_shock_wreath: A character already burning can only draw line of sight to adjacent spaces until the end of its next turn; the GM keeps to that.
wm_phase_ready_mod: You must know roughly where the target is; check that with the GM before attacking through walls.
ms_sekhmet_class_nhp: While SEKHMET drives, it moves toward the closest visible character and attacks it in melee; whoever controls the mech keeps to that.
ms_comp_con_class_assistant_unit: The COMP/CON follows simple orders you give at the start of your turn; whoever controls the mech keeps to them.
ms_scylla_class_nhp: The second trigger (a hostile attacking or using an object you chose) is the table's.
ms_osiris_class_nhp: The First Gate (you control the target's next standard move) is played out at the table.
